r19.intro: Vercel native routing rules use the internal-cell cookie to select alternate application and asset destinations. The x-argos-internal-cell header alone switches only assets, such as images, CSS and JavaScript.

It uses /shop and /shop/* for application requests, /static/* for assets, and its exact owned hostname for cookie scope; the source scopes the cookie to customer subdomains. Separate cookie and header rules implement OR, with cookie first so it also sets the outgoing header. Fixed paths on an existing owned origin recorder represent the four destinations. Its Function only reports what arrived; no Function chooses the route. The destination prefix identifies the test endpoint, followed by the original request path. Query values, order and repeated parameters survived; + was normalized to %20, so this is not byte-for-byte query preservation. Explicit case-sensitive matching accepts literal lowercase true.
